stem: In the excerpt from The Piano Shop on the Left Bank and the excerpt from the article "Those Old Piano Blues," with which statement would both authors most likely agree?

options.label: F
options.text: Old pianos offer a great deal of emotional value to their owners.

options.label: G
options.text: Old pianos are constructed from better materials than new pianos.

options.label: H
options.text: People can learn a lot about the history of pianos from musicians.

options.label: J
options.text: People should learn to play on an acoustic piano before moving to a digital one.
